title: Combat · Command menu, ánimas and maná
description: The battle menu: Atacar, Habilidad, Defender and Huir (in development only, the Dual command sits third, docs/dev-tools.md; there is no mystery command), under the fighter's vitals plate (PV as a wave, the ánima's maná as circles) and ánima bar (one segment per ánima, never wrapping: up to four share it, names shrinking to fit), flanked by Q and E (L and R on a controller), which swap the active fighter's ánima: the menu sweeps, the face lights up, the theme and the skills change. Habilidad opens its skills sideways, each with its cost in circles; △ / Y (I on the keyboard) shows a skill's description and cost beside it. Bernat wears no ánima and has no skills or maná. The option in hand is told by its colour and a step to the right, never by a frame around it.

steps.caption: Gerard wears Papagato: Q · Matemágico · Papagato · E under his plate, its maná as circles

steps.eval: window.extraAnimas = [['Tercera ánima', '#7fc8d8'], ['Cuarta ánima', '#9bd27a']].map(([name, colour]) => { const b = document.createElement('button'); b.type = 'button'; b.tabIndex = -1; b.textContent = name; b.style.setProperty('--chip', colour); return b; }); window.extraAnimas.slice(0, 1).forEach(b => document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"] .anima-chips').append(b));
